scenario: S4 : async COPY offload thread-hop (svc thread -> server worker kthread -> CB_OFFLOAD callback leg -> client)
purpose: Verify remote kcov attribution continuity when the execution owner thread changes: the NFSv4.2 server async COPY is handed from the svc thread (COPY4 request) to a worker kthread (nfsd4_do_async_copy) and the completion returns to the client via a CB_OFFLOAD callback. Patch 0010 wraps the kthread in a saved-work continuation (sunrpc_fuzz_saved_work_start/stop) so its coverage still attaches to the originating remote-request flow. This corpus proves the continuation traverses the hop.

trigger_detail.client: nfs4_copy_file_range: after VFS generic_copy_file_checks clamps count to min(0x2000000, i_size-pos), the source is ftruncate()d to 0x1000000 (16MiB) so the clamped count stays 16MiB > 2*rsize (rsize caps at svc_max_payload = 4MiB => 2*rsize <= 8MiB) => sync=false => nfs42_proc_copy issues COPY4 with ca_synchronous=false and waits for the offload result (handle_async_copy / nfs4_copy_dequeue_callback)
trigger_detail.server: nfsd4_copy: async path spawns the worker kthread nfsd4_do_async_copy; 0010 hooks sunrpc_fuzz_saved_work_start at entry (fs/nfsd/nfs4proc.c:2151) and stop at exit (:2203); nfsd4_send_cb_offload() then delivers CB_OFFLOAD on the backchannel (nfsd4_run_cb/_work, nfsd4_cb_offload_done)

attribution_model.fs/nfsd: Server code collects ONLY under ON remote kcov (off_union is empty); on_only == on_union. Sentinel membership asserted against on_only.
attribution_model.net/sunrpc: Mixed client/server; the ON-attributed slice is on_only. The saved-work continuation runs only in the server kthread, so it must land in on_only.
attribution_model.fs/nfs: Client code collects in both OFF and ON (executor plain kcov); on_only is empty by design. Sentinel presence asserted against on_union (proves the client legs executed during ON trials); OFF presence recorded for context.

verdict_criteria: PASS iff every required sentinel is present under its module rule; observed are recorded for the evidence trail. A missing required sentinel is either a trigger failure (async path not taken) or an attribution gap in 0010 -- discriminate by checking the other legs before calling it a gap.
